activity_summary: You stopped in the lane because a pavan came from an upper window, played very exactly and then again faster. The window is lit gold. The shadow is a head bent at the instrument, and there is no face. You do not know the house. You did not go in. You are not in the picture.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stopped. Not pictured. Did not go in.

entities.name: the lady of the parish
entities.context: Heard, as the playing. Not named, and not seen as a face.

entities.name: the virginals
entities.context: Mentioned in A window lit gold
